description: Validate and identify a crypto wallet address before sending funds: EVM (EIP-55 checksum), Bitcoin (P2PKH/P2SH/SegWit/Taproot), Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron and Solana. Catches typos and wrong-network addresses. $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Price: $0.01. First call returns the x402 PaymentRequired (no charge); retry with payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.

name: crypto_address_validate
title: Validate a crypto address
